clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Office As Vice President Of Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally resigned from his position as the Vice President of Indonesia.
The former Vice President stated the decision was personal and emphasized that national unity remains a priority.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Reveal Details Of Illegal Presidential Surveillance
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief General Suyudi confirmed that former officials directed unauthorized surveillance operations against President Prabowo.
Investigations indicate the operation involved the alleged misuse of surveillance capabilities against various state institutions including the KPK.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Manage Transition After Vice President Resigns
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally departed the Vice Presidential Palace following his resignation.
President Prabowo Subianto is currently coordinating with coalition parties to identify two potential candidates for the vacancy.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Officially Resigns As Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally submitted his resignation as Vice President to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR).
President Prabowo Subianto accepted the resignation, expressing gratitude for the former Vice President's service.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Office Following Degree Revocation
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education has officially revoked the diploma equivalence certificate issued to Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Following the ministry's administrative decision, Gibran Rakabuming Raka announced his resignation from the position of Vice President.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Office
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally resigned from his position of his own volition.
The resignation has resulted in the immediate termination of the impeachment proceedings previously initiated in the House of Representatives.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Indonesian Vice Presidency Role
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially resigned from his post as the Vice President of Indonesia.
The outgoing official met with President Prabowo Subianto at the Presidential Palace to finalize his departure.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Resigns Canceling Impeachment Vote
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially stepped down from his office.
The Indonesian House of Representatives canceled a scheduled plenary session regarding an impeachment motion.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Post
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down following public scrutiny over his overseas education credentials.
The resignation is linked to reports that a submitted certificate failed to confirm his equivalence to a local vocational high school diploma.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Administrative Court Dismisses Lawsuit Over Gibran Credentials
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta Administrative Court ruled that the lawsuit challenging Gibran Rakabuming Raka's high school equivalency certificate is dismissed.
The court decision follows the official revocation of the document by the Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education.
